title: Binance Introduces Revamped Launchpool and BNB Pages for Easier Airdrop Tracking
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is pleased to introduce a revamped  Launchpool  and  BNB  pages, designed to make it easier for users to track and participate in token Airdrops. With  Binance Launchpool  already established as a key platform for earning new tokens, we expanded our offerings last year with  Binance Megadrop  and  Binance HODLer Airdrops . Binance now provides  three types of listings with airdrops , and users who subscribe their BNB to  Binance Earn  can easily stay informed and never miss an opportunity. Revamped Launchpool Page The Launchpool page has been redesigned to improve usability and provide a more efficient experience. Users can now easily track both upcoming and active airdrop projects, with clear visibility into token allocations. Key updates include: Push Notifications : Turn on notifications to stay informed about the latest opportunities and airdrops. Enhanced Navigation : Keep track of activity status and token allocation per project. HODLer Airdrops : Integrated within the Launchpool page, users can now directly view their HODLer Airdrops allocations.  Subscription to Earn : Easily subscribe to  BNB Simple Earn  to automatically participate in each Launchpool. Allocation Overview : View eligible locked positions across Simple Earn Flexible and Locked Products.    New BNB Page The new BNB page offers a clear, comprehensive view of airdrop opportunities and an overview of the benefits of holding BNB on Binance. Key features include: Utility Overview : Learn about the utilities of holding BNB on Binance, including trading fee reductions and VIP benefits.  Airdrops Overview : Stay up to date with all ongoing airdrop opportunities and never miss a chance to participate and maximize rewards. Historical Rewards : View the value of airdropped tokens from past projects and make more informed decisions.   Guide to Binance Airdrop Mechanisms By subscribing BNB to  Binance Simple Earn , users automatically qualify for a variety of airdrops across different projects on Binance. This provides a simple and effective way to access airdrops while earning passive rewards.  Binance offers three distinct airdrop mechanisms, each providing unique opportunities to earn rewards through BNB holdings: 1. Launchpool Users can stake BNB and other eligible tokens in Launchpool to earn new tokens. If their BNB is subscribed to Binance Simple Earn (Locked or Flexible), they automatically qualify for every Binance Launchpool event — no further actions required. 2. Megadrop Megadrop gives users early access to Web3 project tokens before they are listed on Binance. By locking BNB and participating in Web3 quests, users can earn token rewards. 3. HODLer Airdrops HODLer Airdrops rewards users who hold BNB by offering retroactive airdrops based on historical BNB balance snapshots. Users can simply hold their BNB in Binance Simple Earn products and earn more tokens.
